en.t: The author should add a note here:

units.source_text: 明石浦上护送公子返京的人回浦之时，公子曾托带一封信给明石姬。

en.t: When the people from Akashi Bay who had escorted the young lord back to the capital returned to the shore, he entrusted them with a letter for Lady Akashi.

units.source_text: 这封信是瞒过了紫姬而偷偷地写的，缠绵悱恻。

en.t: This letter was written secretly, without Lady Murasaki knowing, and it was filled with tender, sorrowful longing.

units.source_text: 信中有云：“夜夜波涛声中，心绪如何排遣？

en.t: In the letter he wrote: "Night after night, amid the sound of the waves, how am I to ease the turmoil in my heart?
